title: 青少年体育花费：五年涨46%，私募涌入谁买单？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Family spending on youth sports is up 46 percent over the last five years.
segments.zh: 过去五年，家庭在青少年体育上的支出增长了46%。

segments.en: Our senior reporter, Randall Williams, he covers business of sports has been following this story and he joins us now.
segments.zh: 我们的资深记者兰德尔·威廉姆斯，他负责体育商业报道，一直在关注此事，现在加入我们。

segments.en: And Randall by some estimates, this is a $40 billion plus industry that is funded by private equity.
segments.zh: 兰德尔，据估计，这是一个由私募股权资助的、超过400亿美元的产业。

segments.en: And so no surprise then has become hyper competitive and hyper specialized.
segments.zh: 所以毫不意外，它变得高度竞争和高度专业化。

segments.en: Yeah, I mean, when private equity gets into something, of course, they want to maximize profit and that's not always a good thing for youth sports.
segments.zh: 是的，当私募股权介入时，他们当然想最大化利润，这对青少年体育并不总是好事。

segments.en: People think of youth sports as the level before college sports and college sports, of course, is welcoming private equity as well. But with NIO with a bunch of different mechanisms,
segments.zh: 人们认为青少年体育是大学体育之前的阶段，而大学体育也在欢迎私募股权。但有了NIL和各种机制，

segments.en: we, it's sort of the amateur level. And I think youth sports isn't meant to be that, but it's becoming that because you can identify talent earlier on, which therefore could lead to brand collaborations and so many other things.
segments.zh: 它有点像业余水平。我认为青少年体育本不该如此，但正变得如此，因为可以更早发现人才，从而带来品牌合作等。

segments.en: So youth sports is a huge industry that we're seeing private equity get into and other investors as well.
segments.zh: 所以青少年体育是一个巨大产业，我们看到私募股权和其他市场参与者正在进入。

segments.en: How has technology accelerated this? Because we talk about private equity getting in, we talk about NIL, that those are two distinct things, but technology has made it even more hyper intense.
segments.zh: 技术如何加速了这一进程？我们谈到私募股权和NIL，这是两回事，但技术让竞争更加激烈。

segments.en: Well, it's interesting, like when I was growing up, like my dad and my mom would have a film camera that they would shoot it for, but that was just for fun. Like I had my aspirations of going to the NFL ended at 15,
segments.zh: 有趣的是，我小时候，父母会用胶片相机拍摄，但那只是好玩。我15岁时想进NFL的愿望就结束了。

segments.en: but now you have people using apps like GameChanger, which you can literally just film the entire thing, create a highlight reel for your child, and then email it to Scouts themselves. And of course, the supporters behind an AppLite GameChanger
segments.zh: 但现在有人用GameChanger这类应用，直接录下整场比赛，为孩子制作精彩集锦，然后电邮给球探。当然，AppLite GameChanger背后的支持者会投入资金，鼓励用户使用他们的应用来推销自己。

segments.en: are going to pour money into it and say, hey, use our app and then you can go and market yourself.
segments.zh: 他们会投入资金并说，嘿，用我们的应用，然后你就可以去推销自己了。
